mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle, compressing discount rates on equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sudden rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% triggers a tightening cycle, raising risk premiums and compressing equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day returns in tightening periods are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or IC > 0.03 over 3-month rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A concurrent rise in quarterly GDP growth (GDPC1) and monthly federal funds rate decline indicates expansionary policy, boosting corporate earnings expectations and driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises and FEDFUNDS falls in the same month
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or IC < 0.03 over 6-month rolling window despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly decline in unemployment rate (UNRATE) below 4.0% signals labor market strength, enhancing corporate profits and equity valuations, resulting in positive S&P 500 forward returns within 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or IC < 0.03 over 12-month window despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: Rising labor demand (PAYEMS) coupled with falling unemployment (UNRATE) indicates a robust labor market, boosting consumer spending and corporate profits, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: PAYEMS rises and UNRATE falls in the same month
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or IC < 0.03 over 6-month window despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained monthly increase in the industrial production index (INDPRO) reflects expanding supply capacity, which may signal overcapacity and muted growth, yet in a short-term context, initial positive investor sentiment drives 5-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: 5-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or IC < 0.03 over 1-month window despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: In a late-cycle expansion, a sustained drop in CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) below 2.5% signals anticipated soft landing, reducing growth risks and prompting positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: 20d returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or IC < 0.03 over 18-month window despite the signal.

mechanism_narrative: Concurrent rises in housing demand (HOUST) and retail sales (RSAFS) indicate robust demand growth, driving corporate earnings and equity valuations higher, resulting in positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: 60-day returns not significantly positive (p > 0.05) or IC < 0.03 over 2-year window despite the signal.
